# Credits {.unnumbered}

The chapter list was constructed by surveying publicly
available Quarto migration guides and teaching materials,
including the official Quarto documentation at
<https://quarto.org>, the R Markdown to Quarto transition
notes maintained by the Quarto project, and course modules
that adopt Quarto for reproducible reporting, and adopting the
topics common to the majority of them.

Cover artwork generated procedurally by the R script at
`images/build-cover.R`. Watercolor palette: deep slate
through steel and sky to pale mist, anchored on a brand blue
`#39729e` chosen to echo the Quarto project's signature blue.
Typography: Avenir family (Apple system font); body text in
Source Serif 4.
